      "section": "mod-tome/data/texts/tutorial/stats-calc/calc0.lua",
      "source": "It's finally time to stab something.\n\nThere's an orc up ahead; make sure you're wearing your #GOLD#Helmet of Accuracy (+6)#WHITE# from earlier, and go attack him!\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "终于可以攻击点什么东西了……\n\n前面有个兽人，确定你装备了 #GOLD#命中之头盔（+6）#WHITE# 后去攻击他！\n"

      "section": "mod-tome/data/texts/intro-archmage.lua",
      "source": "Welcome #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#.\nYou are an archmage in a world that still fears magic. The people of Angolwen have been trying to mend the world for well over two thousand years now, but they do so in secret.\n\nYou have lived and trained most of your life in Angolwen, calling many people there your friends, but you have grown restless as of late.\nYou want to see the world, maybe even help in what ways you can.\n\nBut for now Angolwen still needs you. The Abashed Expanse, a part of Eyal that was torn apart and thrown into the void during the Spellblaze, is quickly becoming unstable.\nYou have been tasked to investigate and fix the problem.\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "欢迎你 #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#！\n你是一个生活在仍然畏惧魔法的世界中的元素法师。两千多年来，安格利文的人们一直试图修复这个世界，但他们始终秘密行事。\n\n你在安格利文生活并受到训练，那里的很多人是你的朋友，但你不安于现在的生活。\n你想周游世界，并看看你能帮这个世界做点什么。\n\n但目前安格利文仍然需要你。次元浮岛是埃亚尔的一个地区，在魔法大爆炸中被撕裂并抛入虚空，如今正迅速变得不稳定。\n你被指派来调查和解决这个问题。\n"
    },

      "args_order": null,

      "section": "mod-tome/data/texts/tutorial/stats-calc/calc2.lua",
      "source": "If you were wearing your #GOLD#Helmet of Accuracy (+6)#WHITE#, then you should have #LIGHT_GREEN#38 Accuracy#WHITE#, while the orc has #LIGHT_GREEN#48 Defense#WHITE#. The difference is ten in the orc's favor, which is apparently too much for you to be able to hit him.\n\nThere's another orc ahead with slightly lower defense. Go get him!\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "如果你戴上了你的 #GOLD#命中之头盔（+6）#WHITE#，那么你应该拥有 #LIGHT_GREEN#38 命中#WHITE#，而兽人拥有 #LIGHT_GREEN#48 闪避#WHITE#。两者的差值是对兽人有利的 10 点，这显然相差过大，导致你无法命中它。\n\n前面还有另一个闪避稍低一些的兽人。去搞定它！\n"
    }
